title: A giant star swallowed another star. James Webb reveals the aftermath
caption:
Astronomers have witnessed a rare cosmic collision in the Andromeda galaxy. By monitoring the system before and after the merger, the James Webb Space Telescope provided the most detailed look yet at how stars combine.

Source: Sciencedaily - A giant star swallowed another star. James Webb reveals the aftermath

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261120075556.htm

Written in our own words. Credit for the research belongs to the study authors and their institution.
